text_blocks.snippet: Influenza, commonly known as the flu, is a contagious respiratory illness caused by influenza viruses. These viruses primarily infect the nose, throat, and lungs, and can range in severity from mild to severe, sometimes leading to death. Seasonal influenza occurs annually, usually during the fall and winter months in the Northern Hemisphere.
